dedupe_keys.name: meteor nepal flood hazard map fluvial defended for return periods of 1 in 5 10 20 50 75 100 200 250 500 and 1000 years

description: The METEOR project releases a defended-scenario river-flood map set for Nepal, produced by SSBN Ltd (Fathom). Its public Zenodo inventory has ten ODbL 1.0 GeoTIFF depth layers for 5, 10, 20, 50, 75, 100, 200, 250, 500 and 1000-year return periods. The stated grid is 3 arcseconds in WGS84; depth values are metres. The provider describes a two-dimensional shallow-water simulation using MERIT terrain and hydrography. These layers can be paired with the separate Nepal undefended release to explore river-flood exposure of roads, hospitals or substations under alternative protection assumptions. A related catalogue METEOR Nepal entry identifies landslide maps, not these flood depths. A limitation is that Zenodo does not list the actual embankments or protection standards represented by the defended model. The layers are regional guidance, not design flood levels for a specific structure. No raster was downloaded and differences from the undefended set were not measured.
